_readme: Rules for turning Katy's private Google Calendar into the public schedule. Only events matching a class rule are shown with details. Events matching a 'booked' pattern show as an anonymous 'Booked' block. EVERYTHING ELSE IS HIDDEN. Never add student names here.
early_roster_note: Some classes don't open for sign-up until closer to the date. Want a spot now? Text me and I'll put you on the roster early.

classes.title: Dink. Drill. Dominate!
classes.price: $40 per person, paid to coaches (cash, Zelle or Venmo)
classes.blurb: Focused drills and coached gameplay, with a different focus each week. Improve consistency, shot selection and movement, followed by guided play with live feedback.

classes.title: Duos 'n Pros
classes.blurb: Bring your partner. Play the Pros. Diagnose your gameplay. Video analysis and shot-by-shot stats to take home.

classes.title: Coached Round Robin
classes.blurb: Competitive round robin with live coaching between points.

classes.title: Master Class with Katy & Evan
classes.blurb: Train with two of Pictona's top coaches. Each class drills one fundamental, like kitchen volleys, serve & return or resets, with real reps and on-the-spot form fixes.

classes.title: Pickle-Balance
classes.blurb: Core strength and balance for pickleball: single-leg work, squats and holds.

classes.title: Move Your Feet!
classes.blurb: Footwork takes practice, but it will make you speedy and prevent falls. Come learn how to move your feet better on the court.

classes.title: Drill Like a 4.5
classes.blurb: Week-to-week progression for advanced players, one skill focus per session.

offerings.title: Private lessons
offerings.detail: 1-on-1 coaching at Chipshot or Pictona. Open times fill fast — text to book.

offerings.title: Quad Squad
offerings.detail: 90-minute lesson for your group of 4: play, fix the pain points, play again with live feedback. $40 per person.
